features: Fix stale live prices: browser-to-Pionex WebSocket handshakes were rejected with HTTP 403 because browsers send Origin.
Cloudflare Worker now provides /api/monitor/ws and transparently relays the Pionex public trade WebSocket without propagating the browser Origin.
Pionex heartbeat PING/PONG is handled inside the Worker proxy, including timestamp echo.
Subscription pacing is reduced to 4 messages/sec and 100 symbols per connection to remain within Pionex public WebSocket limits.
Every 10 seconds only changed table cells are patched; the current 1D candle and S-State / midline / average-K / CCI-SMA are recalculated from live trades.
Includes v0.3.03 resume-aware R2 kline prewarm and 90-minute GitHub Actions timeout fix.
Adds an hourly GitHub Actions refresh for only the current R2 watchlist so opening the monitor later starts from a recent 1D OHLC baseline before live trades take over.
